def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Full-width colored rows encode a periodic horizontal stripe pattern.
    horizontal = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        nz = [x for x in row if x != 0]
        if len(nz) == w and len(set(nz)) == 1:
            horizontal.append((r, nz[0]))
    if horizontal:
        period = next(p for p in range(1, h + 1)
                      if all(all(c == c2 for r2, c2 in horizontal
                                 if r2 % p == r % p)
                             for r, c in horizontal))
        colors = {}
        for r, c in horizontal:
            colors[r % period] = c
        # Each residue is represented by the encoded stripe(s).
        default = horizontal[0][1]
        return [[colors.get(r % period, default) for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Otherwise the marks encode colors on repeating down-right diagonal bands.
    marks = [(c - r, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]

from collections import Counter, defaultdict

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Horizontal strokes encode a cyclic sequence of row colors.
    rows = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
            if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    if rows:
        period = len(rows)
        phase = {r % period: color for r, color in rows}
        fallback = rows[0][1]
        return [[phase.get(r % period, fallback) for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    marks = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    coords = [lambda r, c: c-r, lambda r, c: r+c]
    counts = [Counter(fn(r,c) for r,c,_ in marks) for fn in coords]
    score = [sum(n*n for n in cnt.values()) for cnt in counts]
    orient = 0 if score[0] >= score[1] else 1
    other = 1-orient

    # Exclude strokes that clearly belong to the crossing, secondary diagonal family.
    by_color = defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in marks:
        by_color[v].append((r,c))
    keep_colors = set()
    for color, pts in by_color.items():
        own = Counter(coords[orient](r,c) for r,c in pts)
        cross = Counter(coords[other](r,c) for r,c in pts)
        own_score = sum(n*n for n in own.values())
        cross_score = sum(n*n for n in cross.values())
        if own_score >= cross_score:
            keep_colors.add(color)
    filtered = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in marks if v in keep_colors]
    if not filtered:
        filtered = marks

    fn = coords[orient]
    bands = [(fn(r,c), v) for r,c,v in filtered]
    period = len(set(k for k,_ in bands))
    phase = {k % period: color for k,color in bands}
    fallback = filtered[0][2]
    return [[phase.get(fn(r,c) % period, fallback) for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(h)]
